items.headline: Man held after Knight Street stabbing leaves victim critical
items.blurb: A 31-year-old man was arrested in the Central Station parking lot after a man was stabbed four times in the back at 299 Knight Street on the night of Oct. 26. He faces felony assault and a prohibited-weapon charge; a judge set $20,000 surety bail and held him on a separate probation violation. The victim was listed in critical but stable condition.

items.headline: Warwick traffic stop turns into chase onto I-95; detective punched
items.blurb: Police say a Providence man sped off from a reckless-driving stop near Jefferson Boulevard in Warwick Oct. 26, crashed into an embankment, punched a Providence police detective and ran onto I-95 before he was caught. He faces 11 new charges and remains held as an alleged bail violator.

items.headline: New Jersey man charged with taking more than $10,000 from an elderly person
items.blurb: A 39-year-old Lodi, N.J., man surrendered at State Police headquarters Oct. 19 and was charged with obtaining more than $10,000 from a person over 65 under false pretenses and elderly exploitation. He was ordered to give up his passport and held on $50,000 surety bail.

items.headline: Weekend DUI arrests on Route 6 and I-95
items.blurb: Troopers charged a 55-year-old East Greenwich man with DUI and refusal after a crash on Route 6 West in Providence Oct. 24, and a 30-year-old Warwick man with DUI and refusal after a stop on I-95 South in Warwick early Oct. 25.

items.headline: State Police detective charged with DUI in Jamestown
items.blurb: Jamestown police stopped an SUV driving on two flat tires on North Main Road late Oct. 15 and charged its driver, a State Police detective from East Greenwich, with suspicion of DUI and refusing a chemical test. State Police called it an open personnel matter.
